narr: A few afternoon thunderstorms, typical for the summertime, produced a few isolated wind gusts that blew down some trees. Locally heavy rain caused flooding on the south side of Chattanooga.
ev: Cars stranded in flood waters at the intersection of Dodson Ave and East 3rd St.
Flooding of roads and yards on North Choctaw Drive, and also near the intersection of Pinewood Ave and Dellwood Place.
lsr: CARS STRANDED AT DODSON AVENUE AND EAST THIRD STREET.
YARDS AND ROADWAY FLOODED ON NORTH CHOCTAW DRIVE.
FLOODING AT PINEWOOD AVENUE AND DELLWOOD PLACE.
